description: This Java source file defines an abstract builder class for creating exceptions related to JSON processing, specifically subclasses of JsonRuntimeException. It provides methods for setting error details such as message, description, cause, and a hyperlink, and mandates subclasses to implement the actual build method.

classes.name: AbstractJsonExceptionBuilder
classes.description: Abstract base implementation for builders which create JsonRuntimeException subtypes, providing common functionality for setting exception details.

methods.name: AbstractJsonExceptionBuilder

methods.description: Validates that the provided error code is not null or empty.

methods.description: Sets the cause (underlying throwable) for the exception.

methods.description: Sets the cause using a supplier.
